basic_info.description:
Step into timeless San Francisco charm with this beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom condo, tucked inside a classic Spanish Mediterranean style building that reflects the elegance and character of the Marina District. Inside, oak hardwood floors gleam throughout, guiding you to a bright and inviting living space anchored by a cozy gas fireplace the perfect spot to unwind after a day by the Bay. The kitchen has been tastefully updated with new appliances and thoughtful finishes, creating a seamless blend of style and function. A rare highlight of this home is the expansive private walkout deck, offering a sunlit retreat for morning coffee, al fresco dinners, or simply soaking up the energy of the neighborhood. Completing the home is a coveted deeded parking space, a true luxury in this sought-after area.

Surrounded by San Francisco's most iconic destinations, you'll find the Marina Yacht Club, Crissy Field Beach, the Palace of Fine Arts, and the open green spaces of the Presidio just moments from your door. Whether you're drawn to waterfront walks, cultural landmarks, or the neighborhood's vibrant cafes and shops, this condo places you in the heart of it all a residence that blends history, comfort, and the best of city living. 

DRE #: 01367626 NMLS ID: 237089

1 year lease term or multi-year leases are available. PGE, Cable, and Internet paid by tenant. 300.00 parking space available in the building.

exteriorFeatures: modern living with all the amenities
